name: Westfall: Farmer Demont offers Riverpaw Genocide to Alliance only (#13727)
contract: #13727 reported Farmer Demont (157002) at Demont's Place in Westfall offering
Riverpaw Genocide (17011, follow-up 17012) to Horde players. Farmer Demont was
authored with neutral-friendly faction 35 and both quests had AllowableRaces = 0
despite being Westfall Stormwind quests (QuestSortID 40, RewardFactionID1 72).
With faction 12 (Stormwind, hostile to Horde) and AllowableRaces 1101 (Alliance):
a level 11 Horde character next to spawn 9950108 cannot take 17011, sees dialog
status 0, and fails to accept 17011; a level 11 Alliance character sees dialog
status 8, accepts and turns in 17011, and unlocks follow-up 17012.

steps.label: Horde player joins world phase 1 where Farmer Demont spawns
Alliance player joins world phase 1 where Farmer Demont spawns
Let login and world spawns settle
SETUP: Farmer Demont (157002) is spawned at Demont's Place
DISCRIMINATING: Horde character cannot take Riverpaw Genocide (17011)
DISCRIMINATING: Farmer Demont shows no quest dialog status to Horde
Horde character attempts to accept Riverpaw Genocide (17011) from Farmer Demont
DISCRIMINATING: Horde quest acceptance is rejected (quest status stays NONE)
Control: Alliance character can take Riverpaw Genocide (17011)
Control: Farmer Demont shows DIALOG_STATUS_AVAILABLE (8) to Alliance
Control: Alliance character accepts Riverpaw Genocide (17011)
Control: 17011 is now active (QUEST_STATUS_INCOMPLETE = 3) for Alliance
Control: mark 17011 objectives complete for Alliance
Control: Alliance character turns in 17011 to Farmer Demont
Control: follow-up Riverpaw Genocide (17012) is takeable for Alliance
Control: Farmer Demont offers follow-up 17012 (DIALOG_STATUS_AVAILABLE = 8) to Alliance
